name: HELIOS 60 kW shipboard laser
description: US Navy Mk 5 Mod 0 HELIOS: 60 kW-class laser plus optical dazzler, hosted by the Aegis Combat System, installed on USS Preble since 2022 and the only such installation. Engaged four UAS in one at-sea counter-UAS demonstration. Single target per engagement. Magazine is bounded by ship power and cooling, not by rounds. Engagement range and the deckhouse-restricted firing arcs are NOT published.

maxRangeM.note: Inventory records 5000 m; the seed value is kept

outputPowerKw.condition: 60 kW-class laser, Mk 5 Mod 0 HELIOS installed on USS Preble
outputPowerKw.source: Navy Times, 4 February 2025, quoted from the search index

beamQualityM2.note: Planning factor: no high-energy laser programme publishes a beam quality. Open optics references put high-power multimode and combined-fibre beams at M squared of about 1.5 to 3; 2.0 is the planning value for every laser in the library.

jitterUrad.note: Planning factor: no high-energy laser programme publishes a pointing jitter. The Airborne Laser Laboratory of the 1980s held about 25 urad and modern beam control is better, so 10 urad at 1 sigma is the planning value for every laser in the library.

apertureM.note: Planning factor: no high-energy laser programme publishes a beam director aperture. Open beam-director literature describes 30 to 50 cm apertures for weapon-class systems; 0.30 m is the planning value for every laser in the library.

dwellToEffectS.note: No dwell time to defeat a drone is published for this system. The programme has released engagement results but no engagement timeline; not established by the public record. The Navy has released the result of the USS Preble engagements but neither the target profiles nor the engagement timeline.
